full_judgment: "It must be remembered that whatever may be the allegation against the accused person or suspect, in the face of the criminal allegation the accused person or suspect must be considered to be innocent, and such presumption of innocence shall be continued until the presumption is rebutted in a free and fair trial conducted in front of an independent and impartial Court or Tribunal. This is the reason as to why a t meticulous investigation is to be conducted by the police investigation officer for the purpose of collecting evidence against the alleged accused person or suspect to connect him with the alleged offence. It is, therefore, undeniably true that meticulous police investigation is of paramount importance before a trial may well be proposed against any accused person or suspect." (page 6) Thus it can safely be said that for a meticulous and effective investigation and to find out the real culprits of the crime if the investigating officer as part of the investigation takes effort to remove the stain and impression of threat from the minds of the witness closely monitors the witness that did not and should not render their evidence unreliable.
